propositions: Recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary, positioned after the under-lock staleness gate and scoped_ids computation but before the first remote issue fetch.
Read-only commands and filtered/preview/dry-run paths must perform zero writes from the recovery operation.
A durable tombstone remains authoritative until explicit unretire; automatic 200, clear_absent, or same-key confirmation cannot revoke it.
Completion failure must perform zero remote calls and preserve the overlap as recoverable evidence for retry.
The repair_at_write_boundary guard must refuse without classification or repository access when the pass is non-write-bearing or scoped, ensuring read-only paths pay no cost.
Explicit unretire removes the tombstone and therefore removes the completion candidate from recovery scope.
